ship_record.deliverable_extra: Three bugs uncovered + fixed by 2-arm scrutiny while opening deferred close-out: (1) wrong method name — orchestrator called mastercamStrategyEngine.recommend() but engine exports selectStrategy(); typo silently threw TypeError for the life of the method, swallowed by empty catch; comparison returned 3 strategies instead of contracted 4. (2) selectBestStrategy ranking — bestScore=0 init meant confidence:0 fallback never overrode strategies[0]; init -1 fixes. (3) Test brittleness — length-4 assertion would pass with all-fallback if both real engines broke; added real-strategy filter assertion (cycle_name !== 'Manual Selection' && confidence > 0) >= 2. Files committed under peer subject 57f0ceb47a [DEV-TOOLS-AUDIT-F3]/U-DEV-TOOL-LEVERAGE-SKILL via commit-collision (peer git commit -a absorbed my staged 2 files); verified via git show 57f0ceb47a — selectStrategy + bestScore=-1 + test-assertion all present on HEAD.

ship_record.bug_fixed_during_close_out: calculateTotalConfidence() in MasterPostProcessorUnifiedAGIEngine.ts produced NaN for every call — `(1 / inv.invocation_time_ms || 0.01)` evaluated to Infinity when invocation_time_ms===0 (orchestrator entry point), poisoning the weighted sum. Fixed with `safeWeight(t) => t > 0 ? 1/t : 0.01`. Caught by R12 fail-loud test — would have silently shipped wrong total_confidence forever otherwise.
